99 The Drive, Hazelhatch Park, Celbridge, Kildare

BrochureContent.Content:
HouseLet Property is delighted to present 99 The Drive, Hazelhatch Park, Celbridge, Co. Kildare, a substantial five-bedroom, four-bathroom home extending to approximately 146 sq. m. and offering generous accommodation over three floors.

Hazelhatch Park is a well-established residential development enjoying a convenient location close to Celbridge village and the many amenities the area has to offer. Schools, shops, cafés, restaurants and recreational facilities are all within easy reach, while commuters are well served by Hazelhatch & Celbridge train station, Dublin Bus services and convenient access to the M4 and surrounding road network.

Internally, No. 99 offers an impressive amount of living and bedroom accommodation arranged across three floors. The property has been freshly painted and is presented in good condition throughout, with carpets also remaining in good order. 

To the rear is a south-facing garden which is not directly overlooked, providing a particularly attractive and private outdoor space. Combined with the property's generous proportions and three-storey layout, this makes No. 99 an appealing option for families requiring additional bedrooms, home-working space or flexible accommodation.

With approximately 146 sq. m. of accommodation, five bedrooms, four bathrooms and a B3 BER rating, the property should also be of interest to investors seeking a substantial residential property in an established Celbridge location.

•	Substantial five-bedroom terraced home
•	Accommodation extending to approximately 146 sq. m.
•	Arranged over three floors
•	Four bathrooms
•	South-facing rear garden
•	Rear garden not directly overlooked
•	Freshly painted throughout
•	Carpets in good condition
•	Excellent potential to further modernise and personalise
•	Gas-fired central heating
•	BER: B3
•	Established Hazelhatch Park location
•	Convenient to Celbridge village and local amenities
•	Accessible to Hazelhatch & Celbridge train station, Dublin Bus services and the M4
•	Suitable for families and investors

Viewing is highly recommended to appreciate the space, flexibility and potential offered by 99 The Drive.
To arrange a viewing or for further information, contact HouseLet Property.
